text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, familiar! What a lovely day!
Did you sleep well last night?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm in top shape! Before going to sleep, I drank the special herbal tea Grandma sent me♪

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It's a magical sleep blend of various herbs grown in my garden,
and it works wonders, you know!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll share some with you as a special treat, huh?
Drink this, and you'll see just how amazing Grandma is!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Sweep Tosho was able to get plenty of rest.
The herbal tea from her beloved grandmother
seemed to give her plenty of energy too!
